tess: Hey team — bringing halcyon-6b into the eval harness. CI runner keeps failing during collate/token padding step. Not sure if it's tokenizer quirks (ZWJ) or the new chat template that pads differently. Anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:

tess: paste of failing log:
```
ERROR ValueError: Inconsistent batch sizes in collate: shapes [(8, 1024), (8, 1023)] -> ValueError while batching requests
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/eval/runner.py", line 238, in batch_loop
    batch = collate_fn(examples)
  File "/srv/eval/collate.py", line 76, in collate_fn
    raise ValueError('token lengths mismatch')
```

liam: which tokenizer variant did you use? halcyon has a newer tokenizer release (v2) that treats zero-width joiner sequences as separate tokens. If your chat template prepends a sentinel + pad, the lengths can differ by 1 per example.

tess: using halcyon-tokenizer@v2.0.1 and chat_template v1 that adds `\u200d` sentinel for role delimiters. Example template: 
```
[ROLE_START]\u200d{role}\u200d[SEP]{content}[ROLE_END]
```

jana: heads-up — we saw quality regressions on Halcyon after q4f quant in another run (factuality down ~3%). Might be orthogonal but want to capture metrics.

quant-ops: noted. Also, the quantized pipeline sometimes changes how pad tokens are represented after postprocessing (we saw a pad id shift in some ONNX exports). Could be a mismatch between tokenizer.pad_token_id and model config.

liam: can you paste the eval-runner collate snippet? Quick check: are you using `pad_to_multiple_of` or dynamic padding?

tess: collate conf from CI: 
```
collate:
  dynamic: true
  pad_to_multiple_of: null
  preserve_special_tokens: false
```

liam: aha — preserve_special_tokens=false + v2 tokenizer + chat template with ZWJ sentinel = recipe for off-by-one. The runner assumes special tokens are stripped before length checks. New tokenizer keeps ZWJ as token, so some sequences have extra token.

arnold-bot: CI status update: GitHub Actions workflow `eval-harness/halcyon-onboard` failed on job `runner-test` (logs available: https://ci.redwood/halcyon/2167890123) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eva: short-term workaround: set `preserve_special_tokens: true` and `pad_to_multiple_of: 8` in collate so that small variances are absorbed. Also add a pre-tokenize normalization that removes leading ZWJ when it's used only as a formatting sentinel.

liam: proposed patch (quick): 
```diff
- preserve_special_tokens: false
- pad_to_multiple_of: null
+ preserve_special_tokens: true
+ pad_to_multiple_of: 8
```
Also add this to the runner validation step before batching: 
```python
# normalize leading zwj used as sentinel
for ex in examples:
    if ex.text.startswith('\u200d'):
        ex.text = ex.text.lstrip('\u200d')
```

quant-ops: run a short metric sweep after fixing collate — check perplexity, factuality (QA EM), and safety regression hooks. If quantization changed tokenization semantics we should run the same exact tokenizer+model export combo used in production.

tess: applied changes locally, reran the failing test — batch now collates. Quick CI run shows no batch error but a small metric delta: PPL +0.18, QA EM -1.6% (on our smoke suite).

jana: EM -1.6% could be noise but flag it. Can you push a canary to the dashboard with both before/after eval curves? We need the exact seed and prompt set.

tess: pushed canary run to dashboard: https://dash.redwood/evals/halcyon/2167890123 (shows side-by-side). Seed 42, promptset: halcyon-smoke-v2.

eva: long-term: we should update the eval harness docs to call out ZWJ/zero-width handling and require explicit pad_token_id validation during model onboarding. Also add a unit test that fuzzes small sentinel tokens in templates.

liam: agree. I'll open a PR with: 1) collate defaults changed, 2) normalization helper, 3) unit test + CI gating.

ci-bot: PR #3217 opened by liam: `fix/eval-collate-halcyon-zwj` — CI: tests running.

tess: thanks all. Leaving this thread with the canary link and PR. If CI passes I'll mark halcyon-6b onboarded with note about q4f quant check. :thumbsup:

liam: if CI shows any quant-export pad id mismatches, ping me, I can add an exporter assertion to catch pad_id drift during ONNX/TF export.

quant-ops: adding a scheduled eval for halcyon-6b quant variants next week so we can measure regression surface.

arnold-bot: CI update: workflow `eval-harness/halcyon-onboard` all jobs passed (2167890489) :tada:

tess: woo! thanks everyone :)
